scope: Raid/event Super Souls — Hit and Broly raid reward families
verification_policy: Promote identities and acquisition families only when independently supported. Preserve secondary effect evidence as reported values when official item-level evidence is unavailable; do not infer drop rates.

records.name: Buu's reached full power!
records.acquisition_source: Hit / Hit Lite Raid individual reward
records.reported_effect: Always reduces Ki recovery speed by 20%; when Ki is maxed out, boosts all attacks by 30%.
records.notes: Secondary catalog notes a discrepancy: in-game description reportedly says 10% while game files list 20%; conflict preserved.

records.name: I'm over 1,000 years old.
records.acquisition_source: NPC Gogoh after completing the base game; also appears as a Hit raid reward
records.reported_effect: After a successful Just Guard, temporarily boosts Strike Skills by 15% for 10 seconds.
records.notes: Raid availability is not treated as the only acquisition route.

records.name: My Ki is building... Overflowing...
records.reported_effect: Always reduces Stamina recovery speed by 40%; when Ki is maxed out, reduces damage taken from all attacks by 20%.
records.notes: Raid reward and effect are represented by independent secondary sources.

records.name: I am going to bathe in your blood!
records.reported_effect: At battle start, temporarily boosts all attack strength; secondary reports describe the boost as XXL.
records.notes: No numeric percentage inferred from the categorical XXL label.

unresolved: Whether every raid variant shares identical reward tables across platforms and reruns.
Numeric conversion of categorical effect labels where not independently item-verified.
